name: University of Turin
summary: Large public university in Turin; three English bachelor's in business, economics with data science and global law, plus English-taught Medicine.

ib.text: A foreign school qualification assessed on Apply@UniTo. Degrees with restricted places select by entrance test; open-access degrees need a non-selective TOLC test.

programmes.name: Business & Management
programmes.about: An undergraduate business and management degree taught in English by Turin's Department of Management.
programmes.ib: Restricted places, selected by entrance test; the rules are in the programme's call.
programmes.selectionNote: Local restricted number of places, filled by an entrance test ranking. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Economics and Finance with Data Science
programmes.about: Economics and finance combined with data science, taught in English by the Department of Economics, Social Studies, Applied Mathematics and Statistics.
programmes.ib: Limited places for 2026-27, selected by entrance test; the rules are in the programme's call.
programmes.selectionNote: Limited number of places, filled by an entrance test ranking. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Global Law and Transnational Legal Studies
programmes.about: Global and transnational law taught in English by Turin's Department of Law.
programmes.ib: Admission rules are in the programme's call; check whether it has restricted places or a TOLC entry test.
programmes.selectionNote: Admission by the programme's call. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Medicine and Surgery (MedInTO)
programmes.about: Turin's six-year medical degree taught in English (MedInTO), run by the Department of Clinical and Biological Sciences.
programmes.ib: National admission test in English; in 2026 it was held on 29 September.
programmes.selectionNote: Places set nationally and filled by the admission test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: The 2027-28 calls are not out yet. In 2026 the first call for bachelor's ran 19 February–15 April, with a later EU-only call for restricted-place degrees from 1 July to 14 September.
There is one intake a year and the academic year starts in October.
Several of Turin's other English offers are master's degrees or English curricula inside Italian-taught degrees.
